bck-billing: details variant marker; styled via .bck-details + .bck-details > summary/.bck-details__body
bck-card--offer: card variant marker on styled .bck-card (offering page); chrome via card header/body recipe
bck-check__input: checkbox input styled via .bck-pub .bck-check input element selector
bck-details__summary: summary styled via .bck-details > summary element selector
bck-device-new: JS mount region (settings.js #bck-device-new); hidden until token issue fills it
bck-field--check: field variant marker wrapping label.bck-check + hint/error rows
bck-form--stack: layout marker on styled .bck-form (base already stacks fields)
bck-intake__summary: summary styled via .bck-intake > summary element selector
bck-invoice: page-scope marker on styled .bck-pub; layout owned by .bck-invoice__sheet
bck-list-cards__item: items styled via .bck-list-cards > li element selector
bck-review-form: JS hook (public.js review submit); fields via .bck-card__body + .bck-field
bck-settings-form: JS hook (settings.js section saves) on styled .bck-card form
bck-transfer-report: dialog id/JS mount marker on styled .bck-dialog (transfer.js fills by id)
bck-upload-form: JS hook (public.js upload submit) on styled .bck-form
bck-waitlist-join: JS hook (public.js waitlist submit); styled via .bck-waitlist form
